recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast urban portrait featuring a male subject in a black leather jacket against a textured, vibrant yellow background, characterized by a DIY 'label-maker' typographic style and a warm, saturated color palette.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's dark leather texture against a flat, saturated yellow field
Horizontal label tape at top-left balanced by vertical label tape at bottom-right
Subject's gaze directed towards the viewer while body is angled away
coreInvariants: High-gloss black leather jacket with visible highlights
White rectangular strips for text placement

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the right two-thirds of the frame, cropped at the waist and shoulder.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and dark glasses serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye moves from the subject's face to the horizontal text strip at the top left, then down the leather jacket to the vertical text strip on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant yellow negative space in the upper left quadrant.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Saturated yellow background providing high energy and contrast.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black and dark browns in the subject's clothing and hair.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White text strips providing clean, bright highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background against low-value, high-contrast subject details.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used in two different orientations.

candidateDirections.reason: Standard typewriter aesthetic with slab serifs.
Classic monospaced look with slightly more character.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A portrait of a man with short hair and large black glasses wearing a shiny black leather jacket, looking towards the camera. The background is a solid, textured vibrant yellow wall. High contrast lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a horizontal white rectangular strip in the top left corner with monospaced lowercase typewriter text widely spaced. Add a vertical white rectangular strip in the bottom right corner with the same text style oriented vertically.

verificationChecks: Is the background a saturated yellow?
Is the text on white rectangular strips?
Is the font monospaced and widely tracked?
Does the leather jacket have high-gloss highlights?

mustAchieve: High contrast between black leather and yellow background

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the yellow is not greenish or orange.
Check that the text strips do not obscure the subject's face.
Verify the leather texture looks realistic and reflective.
Confirm the vertical text is readable.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Portrait + Saturated Yellow Backdrop + Leather Texture + Monospaced Label-Tape Typography
